units.source_text: 夕雾右大臣家有许多女公子，夕雾本想将一人配给匂皇子，一人配给薰中将。

en.t: The Minister of the Right Yugiri had many daughters, and he had thought of marrying one to Prince Niou and another to Captain Kaoru.

units.source_text: 但他曾听见薰中将说：“母亲在世期间，我至少必须朝夕奉侍。”

en.t: But he had once heard Captain Kaoru say, "As long as my mother is alive, I must at least attend on her morning and evening."

units.source_text: 因此未便向薰中将开口。

en.t: For that reason, it was not convenient for him to broach the matter with Captain Kaoru.

units.source_text: 夕雾原也顾虑到薰中将和他的女儿血缘太近，

en.t: Yugiri had also been concerned from the start that Captain Kaoru and his daughter were too closely related by blood,

units.source_text: 然而除了薰中将和匂皇子之外，世间实在找不出不亚于此二人的女婿来，

en.t: yet apart from Captain Kaoru and Prince Niou, there truly seemed to be no son-in-law in the world who was not inferior to those two,

units.source_text: 侍妾藤典侍所生六女公子，比正妻云居雁所生诸女相貌漂亮得多。

en.t: The sixth daughter, born to his concubine Fuji no Naishi, was far more beautiful than the daughters born to his principal wife, Kumoi no Kari.

units.source_text: 长大后性情也很贤淑，可谓十全无缺。

en.t: When she grew up, her disposition too was wise and gentle, so that one could call her flawless.

units.source_text: 只因母亲出身低微，世人对她不甚重视。

en.t: Only because her mother was of low rank did people fail to value her very highly.

units.source_text: 埋没了这般美质，夕雾觉得十分可怜。

en.t: Yugiri felt great pity that such fine qualities should remain hidden.

units.source_text: 一条院的落叶公主膝下没有子女，生涯颇感寂寞，

en.t: Princess Ochiba at the Ichijo residence had no children and felt her life to be rather lonely,

units.source_text: 夕雾就将这六女公子迎归一条院，叫她做了落叶公主的义女。

en.t: so Yugiri brought this sixth daughter to the Ichijo residence and made her Princess Ochiba's adopted daughter.

units.source_text: 他想：“找个自然的机会，装作无意模样，教薰中将和匂兵部卿亲王看看这个女儿，

en.t: He thought, "If I find a natural occasion and, as if by chance, let Captain Kaoru and Prince Niou, the Minister of War, see this daughter,
she is sure to catch their notice and draw their attention.

units.source_text: 这两个人都善于鉴别女人姿色，必然会赏识她。”

en.t: Both of them are skilled judges of women's beauty, so they will certainly appreciate her."

units.source_text: 于是对六女公子不采用严格的教育，却教她学习时髦，培养趣味，度送风流生活，以期多多地牵惹青年男子的心目。

en.t: Thus he did not subject the sixth daughter to a strict education, but instead taught her to follow fashion, cultivate refined tastes, and live an elegant life, hoping she would strongly attract the hearts and eyes of young men.
